review: Read complete room connection panel and test file. First-party React code and mocked room/Auth0/Discord/native fixtures. No live bearer, profile state, audio, invitations, assets or private Git history exported.

Native room authorization remains purpose-scoped, owner-initiated and separate from account linking, task pairing and source admission. Recovery distinguishes a saved grant under recheck from denied service access; the authorization deadline and cancellation are visible.

Joins use an authority/room/invitation-derived request key and no automatic repeat. Access denial and account/disconnect changes clear rooms. Explicit browser opening names the selected authority and room.

Task selection can be reviewed before room text admission while full mission controls remain separate. A single text owner retains drafts across portal changes. Ordinary human conversation does not trigger developer interpreter reads.

Discord bridging requires the exact active GPT Live session and verified ticket/participant consent at its separate boundary. Hosted Minecraft context is read-only and tied to an explicit source/world; world changes release the existing context selection. These are source behavior and mocked tests, not live qualification.
Fixed a post-R379 presentation bug: the shared request helper accepted responses after its abort deadline. The helper now rejects them. Two regressions failed before and all 33 tests passed after.

Remaining review concern: hosted source-list and source-selection callbacks do not carry a separate room/session generation check. The common abort check now protects canceled requests, but switching selected rooms during these requests needs a focused follow-up before installed continuity acceptance.
Two canonical files changed; line-ending normalization is the only export transformation.
